### User interactions

#### Mouse interactions

| Control or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Using the component | Complete the puzzle using the editable cells; fixed clues cannot be changed. |
| Using the component | Use the displayed assistance controls to check or reveal information when available. |
| Using the component | The puzzle's messages indicate progress and completion. |

#### Keyboard interactions

| Key or gesture | Result |
| --- | --- |
| <kbd>Tab</kbd> / <kbd>Shift</kbd>+<kbd>Tab</kbd> | Moves among assignments, assistance options, undo and redo controls. |
| Number keys | Enters a digit in the focused letter assignment. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Open User Help for the component under the pointer, or the focused component if none is hovered. Include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
| <kbd>Ctrl</kbd>+<kbd>Alt</kbd>+<kbd>?</kbd> | Choose a component from the hierarchy under the pointer, or around the focused component, then open its help. <kbd>Alt</kbd> is <kbd>Option</kbd> on macOS; include <kbd>Shift</kbd> if needed to type <kbd>?</kbd>. |
